stories.text: Tavi put their name on Suri’s finest bowl to win the fair prize
Ben borrowed a fine coat and told everyone he had bought it in the city
Pim hid the last honey jars until his neighbours offered twice the price
Mira moved the mark on her flour scoop to make each sale a little smaller
Bram took flowers from the shared garden to decorate only his own stall
Rosa told a table of customers that Vesa’s tea tasted like ditch water
Hal blamed the rain for a late delivery after spending the morning at the inn
Otto promised to introduce Wren’s song but used the whole hour for his own speech
